preview.evidence: 正在服务的 HTML 与本轮验收构建逐字节一致。

dashboardChecks: 01 compact idea above progress, full-height papers to the right
02 inspiration is plain selectable text and uses a native dark primary action
03 manual idea refresh changes one question and persists on reload
04 exploration carries the refreshed query and project without sending
05 paper feed shows exactly four structured cards per page and safe external icon links
06 paper arrows reach every paper with bounded navigation and keyboard focus
07 project windows keep every project reachable and independent
08 tasks show type icons, real descriptions and compact progress context
09 each group shows at most three tasks without pagination and full lists retain project scope
10 agent summary counts current exceptions and follows state changes
11 manual navigation never changes on a timer
12 desktop rows fit without overlap, mobile reflows without horizontal scroll
13 empty loading and failed papers remain distinct, cached papers stay available
14 light dark contrast and keyboard focus remain clear
15 long questions stay fully readable and an empty workspace offers creation
16 cached and fresh papers require life-science title and project relevance checks
scope: Isolated browser storage, deterministic Crossref responses; no real model generation or device execution.
